exposure: Etiology of respiratory distress (e.g., Respiratory Distress Syndrome)
Initial clinical presentation of respiratory distress (including severity)
cohort: A cohort of 144 neonates with respiratory distress admitted to the Neonatal intensive care unit at Rohilkhand medical college and hospital, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh were studied.
finding: The study found a 56.94% survival rate and 13.88% mortality among neonates with respiratory distress, with varying severities categorized by Silvermann Anderson and Downe scoring systems, and Respiratory Distress Syndrome being a major cause.
birth_weight: Varied, with 62.5% of neonates weighing between 1500-2500 grams.
gest_age: Varied, with 65.97% of neonates being preterm (born before 37 weeks).
